title: Global Security Briefing — 20 May 2026
bluf: The PLA Eastern Theater Command has activated J-20 stealth fighter squadrons and Type 055 destroyers for sustained live-fire exercises near the Taiwan Strait median line, marking the highest readiness posture since 2022. Iran's Fordow enrichment facility continues 60% production despite signals of renewed JCPOA talks, while NATO's Baltic flank deployment responds to a drone incursion that collapsed Latvia's coalition government.

headline_judgments.claim: PLA exercises near Taiwan will continue for at least 10 more days with potential escalation to blockade drills
Iran will agree to IAEA snap inspections within 30 days in exchange for sanctions relief on oil exports
At least one additional NATO member state will report a drone incursion on its territory within 7 days
US semiconductor export controls will expand to 3 new categories targeting AI training hardware
Brent crude will trade above $85/barrel within 14 days driven by Taiwan Strait risk premium

sections.title: 1 ASIA-PACIFIC SECURITY — TAIWAN STRAIT
sections.narrative: People's Liberation Army (PLA) activity around Taiwan has sustained elevated tempo through the final quarter of 2024 and into 2025, with the PLA Eastern Theater Command conducting the "Joint Sword-2024B" exercises in October 2024 — a multi-axis envelopment drill involving the Shandong carrier strike group, coast guard formations, and approximately 153 aircraft tracked in a single 25-hour window, a record daily incursion across the Taiwan Strait median line. December 2024 saw a further unannounced surge featuring roughly 90 PLA Navy and China Coast Guard hulls dispersed across the First Island Chain, which Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense characterized as the largest maritime mobilization in nearly three decades. sections.title: 2 MIDDLE EAST & IRAN — NUCLEAR PROGRAM
sections.narrative: Iran's nuclear program has crossed thresholds that render the 2015 JCPOA framework substantively obsolete. The IAEA's November 2024 Board of Governors report assessed Iranian stockpiles of uranium enriched to 60% U-235 at approximately 182 kilograms — sufficient, if further enriched to weapons-grade, for three to four nuclear devices. Configuration changes at the Fordow Fuel Enrichment Plant (FFEP), where Iran reconfigured IR-6 centrifuge cascades to enable rapid 60% production, were notified in December 2024 following Iranian retaliation for the November IAEA censure resolution co-sponsored by the E3 and United States. sections.title: 3 NATO EASTERN FLANK
sections.narrative: NATO's eastern flank has experienced a substantive deterioration in baseline security through late 2024. Repeated drone incursions into Romanian, Latvian, and Polish airspace — most notably the November 2024 Shahed-136 debris recoveries in Latvia and the recurring incursions over Romania's Tulcea County — have prompted activation of Article 4 consultations and the standing up of integrated air defense surge cells. Poland reinforced its eastern frontier with the "Eastern Shield" program, a €2.3 billion fortification effort along the Belarusian and Kaliningrad borders incorporating anti-drone meshes, hardened command nodes, and pre-positioned engineering obstacles. sections.title: 4 GLOBAL FINANCE & MARKETS
sections.narrative: Global financial markets are exhibiting a layered risk-on/risk-off bifurcation reflecting geopolitical premium pricing alongside resilient US growth data. Gold, the canonical safe-haven, traded above $2,700/oz through Q4 2024 and into early 2025, with central bank purchasing — particularly from the People's Bank of China, which resumed reported acquisitions in November 2024 after a six-month pause, and from the Reserve Bank of India — providing structural support beyond speculative flows.
